title: Choose the correct installer and understand availability, sizes and verification limits
goal: Use the public download/fallback controls without mistaking release metadata, storage accessibility or a completed transfer for trusted installation and working access.
prerequisites: Internal source-only local preview; original guide retains its23ceb source pin and unchanged bytes. These selected files also match this new093243 source snapshot, not a currently shipped/installed release.

Choose the actual operating system/CPU architecture and follow supported organization policy. No local machine, current remote release, artifact bytes, signature, inbox or installed session was examined.
This supplements existing native sign-in, shared-site navigation and historical release records; it does not supersede or extend public v0.1.21 acceptance to newer source/installers.
permissions: Public link navigation/read/download grants no role, entitlement, provider connection or operational approval. Browser saving a file is distinct from executing/installing it.
Never bypass organizational software controls because a manifest flag, release body, .asc or digest exists. Require appropriate artifact/signing and clean-host verification before acceptance.
Do not guess binary URLs, approve unsigned execution, start a paid build, republish installers or alter service/database configuration from these instructions.

steps.instruction: website.download.hero-choose: Choose your installer when the hero cannot identify a Windows/Linux hint, including Mac browsers.
steps.expectedState: Follows #downloads, not an automatic architecture check or installer. There is no explicit focus handler; choose the actual Apple Silicon/Intel platform yourself.

steps.instruction: website.download.hero-platform: Inspect the hero Download for Windows/Linux destination for the intended workstation.
steps.expectedState: The user-agent hint checks Windows before Linux. runtimeReady===true plus that asset produces a direct snapshot URL; otherwise it uses the fixed platform resolver. This is not CPU/OS proof or a fresh per-click readiness check.

steps.instruction: website.download.mac-arm: Choose Download for macOS for Apple Silicon only for the intended architecture.
steps.expectedState: Uses manifest macos-arm URL only when ready and present; fallback resolver uses platform=mac-arm. A link/download does not install, verify bytes, sign in or connect providers.

steps.instruction: website.download.mac-intel: Choose Download for macOS for Intel only for an Intel machine.
steps.expectedState: Uses manifest macos-intel URL or fixed platform=mac-intel resolver. Browser MacIntel text is not used as trusted CPU evidence.

steps.instruction: website.download.windows: Review Windows signing and organization software policy before choosing Download for Windows.
steps.expectedState: Uses windows-x64 asset or platform=windows resolver. Trusted signing/SmartScreen acceptance remains unresolved; reported signing is not certificate/reputation/clean-host proof.

steps.instruction: website.download.linux: Choose Download for Linux and inspect the actual filename.
steps.expectedState: Uses linux-x64 asset or platform=linux resolver. UI calls it AppImage; metadata can choose deb/rpm if AppImage is absent. A download does not authorize chmod, execution or bypass of controls.

steps.instruction: website.download.demo: Use Explore the web demo when the public page offers it.
steps.expectedState: Opens /demo; scripted/browser sample is not native installation or live operational acceptance. Alternate cockpit branch instead links /control/integrations and does not qualify its host/provider setup.

steps.instruction: website.download.installation-help: Follow Desktop installation guide, Troubleshooting or Approval workflow for the actual version.
steps.expectedState: Opens /docs/desktop-install, /docs/troubleshooting or /docs/approval-workflow. These links do not verify the installed build, grant consent or execute a plan.

steps.instruction: website.download.account-contact-supporters: Choose Account help, Contact us or Founding Supporters for its distinct purpose.
steps.expectedState: Account help requires browser account context; Contact is a separate recording flow; Founding Supporters is development support, not support entitlement or purchase acknowledgement.

steps.instruction: website.download.previous-releases: Follow a listed Previous desktop releases entry only after reviewing the intended version.
steps.expectedState: Opens its manifest htmlUrl in a new tab with noreferrer. Older published release is not a local development build or automatically the correct/supported installer.

steps.instruction: website.download.release-record: Use View release record where the manifest supplies it.
steps.expectedState: Opens release htmlUrl in a new tab. Review independently authenticated checksums/signatures where provided; this page has no per-installer digest/signature action and performs no local verification.

steps.instruction: website.download.fallback-return: On Installer availability choose Return to downloads to check again.
steps.expectedState: Opens /download anew, not resuming an old download. Runtime-reason preview may redirect after a storage recheck; storage success is not installation, sign-in or entitlement success.

steps.instruction: website.download.fallback-contact: Use Contact support on Installer availability if further help is needed.
steps.expectedState: Opens mailto:support@visionxixlabs.com in the local mail handler, not a recorded/sent/received support request or authorization to disclose credentials.

expectedOutcome: Select a version/platform-appropriate source destination or understand why it is unavailable; no verified artifact, trusted installation, customer session or deployment outcome is inferred.
limitations: Thirteen proposed documentation families cover eleven original table groups plus two fallback links. Hero variants share a conditional source link; grouped links/conditional release rows are not unique DOM/runtime-control counts. Shared header/footer belongs to its separate guide.

One mount-time manifest fetch has shallow envelope validation and ignores late results after unmount, without abort/polling/in-page retry. A ready snapshot can become stale; a direct artifact link bypasses the resolver readiness recheck at click time.

Displayed size is per-platform installer bytes in decimal MB/kB/bytes, not installed footprint or a capability/quality benchmark. Invalid/nonpositive/noninteger bytes return unavailable; compare exact file/platform/version before explaining a mismatch.

Manifest reports copy metadata URLs/bytes/optional digest/signature sidecar and machine-readable body flags; none independently authenticates downloaded bytes, publisher, notarization or trust reputation.

The release builder has a per-process60-second cache, no paging/asset HEAD/download verification or concurrent-miss coalescing. Missing/unreachable metadata and deeper shape failures have different paths; no universal friendly fallback guarantee.

The five selected storage reads are accessibility probes only. They do not verify all schema compatibility, installation, sign-in, billing entitlement, provider connection or end-to-end runtime readiness.
Windows trusted signing/SmartScreen and clean-host acceptance remain open. No authentic media/browser/AT/editorial/customer/retrieval or new public-release acceptance exists here.
recovery: During metadata loading/failure use the explicit platform resolver rather than a guessed URL. Reload/reopen deliberately for a fresh metadata request; there is no page Retry button or automatic resumed transfer.

Resolver JSON400 invalid platform,503 storage-unavailable and404 missing asset differ from browser302 fallback; unexpected exceptions are not guaranteed friendly. Preserve the original platform/version observation.
Fallback uses reason, not a platform-specific machine inspection. A recovered storage redirect does not prove a working installer or account; verify subsequent steps independently.

If filename, size, version, trust or outcome is uncertain, preserve exact evidence and contact the supported route; do not override safety prompts, resend consumed actions or mutate settings as a workaround.
